Create a mortality data object

Source: R/mort_data.R
mort_data.Rd

Constructs a mort_data S3 object that encodes stratified mortality data as a 3D array with metadata about ages, years, and groups (strata).

Usage

mort_data(
  mx,
  ages,
  years,
  groups,
  pop = NULL,
  cause = NULL,
  age_labels = NULL,
  smoothed = FALSE
)

Arguments

mx

3D array [n_ages x n_years x n_groups] of mortality rates.

ages

Integer vector of age-group start values (e.g. c(30, 35, 40, 90)).

years

Integer vector of calendar years.

groups

Group metadata. Accepted formats:

  • A data.frame with one row per group and columns defining strata (e.g. data.frame(sex = c("M","F"), quintile = c(1,2))). This is the recommended format for flexible plotting with facet_by/color_by.

  • A named list with equal-length vectors (converted to data.frame).

  • A character vector of group labels (stored as single column "group" — faceting by sub-dimensions will not be possible).

At most 3 group columns are supported.

pop

Optional 3D array of population exposure (same dims as mx).

cause

Optional character label for the cause of death.

age_labels

Optional character vector of age-group labels (e.g. "30-34", "35-39"). Derived from ages if omitted.

smoothed

Logical; has the data been smoothed?

Value

A mort_data object (list with class attribute).
